parent.description: Config type instance that contains this config child.

id.description: Auto-generated id of the instance group

state.description: State of the instance group. Do not set as input.

runningInstanceCount.description: Number of active instances currently running in the group. Do not set as input.

instances.description: Status of all instances inside this group. Do not set as input.

groupName.description: The name of the instance group chosen by the user

instanceType.description: The type of all instances in the group. Note that all instances in the same group must have the same instance type

requestedInstanceCount.description:
Number of requested instances in the group. Note that MASTER instance group only allows 1 instance.
CORE and TASK instance groups allow any number of instances.
